title: Descending horn filtration for a four-block ordinal collapse
statement:
Use standard simplices, horns and degreewise pullbacks from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. A simplicial subset means a degreewise subset closed under all simplicial operators; union and intersection are taken degreewise. Let $N\geq3$ and $1<i<N$ be integers. Let $c:\Delta^N\to\Delta^3$ be induced by the monotone vertex map
$$c(k)=\begin{cases}0&k<i-1,\\1&k=i-1,\\2&k=i,\\3&k>i.\end{cases}$$
There exist an integer $m\geq1$, simplicial subsets $K_m\subseteq\cdots\subseteq K_1\subseteq K_0=\Delta^N$, and nondegenerate faces $\sigma_j=\Delta^{S_j}\subseteq\Delta^N$ for $1\leq j\leq m$, where $S_j\subseteq\{0,\ldots,N\}$, such that the following hold. The faces $\sigma_j$ enumerate exactly once the faces whose vertex sets map surjectively onto $\{0,1,2,3\}$ under $c$, in nonincreasing dimension, with $\sigma_1=\Delta^N$. Put $n_j=|S_j|-1$, and let $p_j$ be the position of $i$ in the increasing ordering of $S_j$, numbered starting at zero. Then $3\leq n_j\leq N$, $1<p_j<n_j$, the vertex immediately preceding $i$ in $S_j$ is $i-1$, and $n_j<N$ for $j>1$. Under the increasing-order identification $\sigma_j\cong\Delta^{n_j}$,
$$K_j\cap\sigma_j=\Lambda_{p_j}^{n_j},\qquad K_{j-1}=K_j\cup\sigma_j\quad(1\leq j\leq m).$$
The endpoints are $K_1=\Lambda_i^N$ and $K_m=\Delta^N\times_{\Delta^3}\Lambda_2^3$, viewed as subsets of $\Delta^N$.

This serves the combinatorial subargument in Step 5 of the inner-horn comparison in the inherited operadic-extension branch of prop-coef-integral-exceptional-adjoint. Read nonincreasing in the inconsistent ordering sentence, as required by sigma_1 = Delta^N. Read online 2026-10-17; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical/combinatorial assertion.
